item.title: Addressing Indiana’s Housing Shortage: Unlocking Residential Development Opportunities on Brownfield Sites
item.description: Discover how our initiative is addressing Indiana's housing shortage by redeveloping Brownfield sites into residential opportunities. Learn how we help cities revitalize underutilized land at little to no cost.

item.title: EPA Finalizes Rules to Ban TCE and Phase Out PCE Under the Toxic Substances Control Act
item.description: EPA Finalizes Rules to Ban TCE and Phase Out PCE. Major impacts on dry cleaning and related industries.

item.title: EnviroForensics Welcomes Michael Potter as Senior Project Manager
item.description: EnviroForensics welcomes Michael Potter as Senior Project Manager. With 23+ years of expertise in environmental investigation, remediation, and emergency response, he strengthens our ability to deliver strategic, cost-effective solutions.

item.title: EPA Postpones Toxic Substances Control Act Final Rule and Effective Dates for Banning All Uses of TCE
item.description: Court-ordered stay and regulatory freeze delay EPA’s TCE ban, giving dry cleaners and industry more time to prepare

item.title: EnviroForensics Strengthens Leadership to Support Growth and Client Success
item.description: EnviroForensics promotes Scott Powell, Nick Hill, and Kimberly Hunnicutt, strengthening its leadership team to support continued growth and deliver exceptional client solutions.

item.title: What Drycleaners Need to Know: The Trump Administration and Environmental Regulations
item.description: Learn how changing federal environmental regulations under the Trump administration impact drycleaners—and why now is the time to protect property value and tap into historical insurance coverage before stricter rules return.

item.title: EPA Refines PFAS Action Plan Under New Administration: Progress, Promises, and Points of Concern
item.description: Over the past few weeks, the EPA has announced major updates to its PFAS Action Plan—introducing stricter guidelines for industry discharges, extending drinking water compliance deadlines, and expanding support for impacted communities.

item.title: Wisconsin Supreme Court Ruling Legitimizes DNR Authority—Why It Matters for Contaminated Site Owners
item.description: The Wisconsin Supreme Court affirms DNR’s authority to enforce environmental cleanup without formal rulemaking. Learn what this means for site owners, emerging contaminants like PFAS, and historical insurance reconstruction.

item.title: Turning Challenges into Opportunities: Redeveloping Indiana’s Most Stubborn Properties
item.description: Discover a proven roadmap for Brownfield redevelopment in Indiana — from funding cleanup to transforming contaminated sites into community assets.

item.title: 30 Years of Solving What Others Couldn’t
item.description: EnviroForensics celebrates 30 years of environmental investigation and remediation, delivering strategic solutions aligned with technical, regulatory, and financial goals.

item.title: Preparing for PFAS in Commercial Real Estate
item.description: PFAS will now be a consideration in Phase I ESAs. Historically, PFAS were considered out-of-scope items for Phase I ESAs. Beginning July 8, 2024, the PFAS compounds PFOA and PFOS will need to be assessed during Phase I ESAs.
